intro: Call to Arms is a Horde military initiative directed by Drum Fel from the outpost of Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. Threatened by an alliance between the local Witherbark forest trolls and Boulderfist ogres, the Horde launches a preemptive campaign against the Witherbark to secure their foothold in the region.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres of Arathi are working together to rid us from this land, but we shall not meet our fates at their, or anyone else's, hand. We will slay them and show them that we, too, have a home here.
The trolls turned their backs to us; the ogres would use us for food and bedding if we allowed them to--these things shall not be.
We start our attack on the Witherbark trolls to the south of here. Slay them in droves, and only return when their camps run thick with blood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The signs of war are upon your garments, and sweat drips from your brow. Good, very good indeed.
